title: Fixed Oval Tank and Spread Lattice Boom Sprayer
description: One newly authored whole fixed towable field-sprayer exterior. A broad longitudinal oval tank with closed domed end profiles and a top filler cap sits in two cross saddles above a full two-wheel chassis. A long triangular drawbar terminates in a genuinely open hitch eye, with a separate finite parking foot beneath. A rear upright lift-style frame carries two spread shallow triangular lattice boom wings, a long low distribution line and repeated short nozzle bodies; a front compact pump-shaped housing and one continuous exterior hose complete the assembly. Unlike a wearable backpack sprayer or hand paint gun this is a full wheeled trailed tank and wide boom rig, with no imported old machinery. One static model zero scenes.
